Name: Tomato Basil Pasta
Instructions: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions. 2. In a pan, sauté garlic in olive oil. 3. Add tomatoes and basil, simmer for 15 minutes. 4. Toss pasta with sauce. 5. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

Name: Chicken Tikka Masala
Instructions: 1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices. 2. In a pot, sauté onions and ginger-garlic paste. 3. Add marinated chicken and cook until browned. 4. Add tomato puree and simmer for 20 minutes. 5. Serve with rice or naan.

Name: Beef Tacos
Instructions: 1. Brown ground beef in a pan. 2. Add taco seasoning and water, simmer for 10 minutes. 3. Assemble tacos with beef, lettuce, cheese, and salsa. 4. Serve with sour cream.

Name: Spaghetti Bolognese
Instructions: 1. Sauté onion and garlic. 2. Brown ground beef. 3. Add tomato sauce and simmer. 4. Cook spaghetti. 5. Serve sauce over spaghetti and top with Parmesan cheese.

Name: Chicken Fajitas
Instructions: 1. Slice chicken and vegetables. 2. Season chicken and vegetables with fajita seasoning. 3. Sauté chicken and vegetables until cooked. 4. Warm tortillas. 5. Serve chicken and vegetables in tortillas with salsa and sour cream.
